create_BaseModelParams: create a BaseModelParams instance with a model name and model parameters for ensemble configuration
create_EnsembleParams: create an EnsembleParams object with a list of BaseModelParams to configure multiple base models
fit_BaseEnsemble: fit a BaseEnsemble model by calling fit to train all base models in parallel using multiprocessing
predict_BaseEnsemble: predict future values from a fitted BaseEnsemble by calling _predict_all with a forecast horizon
review_BASE_MODELS: review the BASE_MODELS dictionary mapping model names to ARIMA, HoltWinters, SARIMA, Prophet, Linear, and Quadratic classes
